# `chrome-cdp cpu-throttle`

Slow the CPU down by a factor (4 = four times slower)

```text
chrome-cdp cpu-throttle [OPTIONS] <RATE>
```

Arguments:

- `<RATE>`: How many times slower (1 or `off`: full speed)

```text
Examples:
  chrome-cdp cpu-throttle 4
  chrome-cdp cpu-throttle off
```
